extension.summary: Find and remove the XCPE botnet from this Android TV box
extension.description: Antivirus-style cleaner for the XCPE / Videostrong (MECOOL) TV-box botnet and the proxyware it loads. Connects to the box's own ADB (turn on USB debugging and ADB over network first), removes confirmed threats automatically and verifies with a re-scan. IOCs: Google Threat Intelligence and Synthient, November 2026.
